messages.subject: problem with loadSample()
parts:
Hi all,

I am using the function loadSample() in a loop to read the sound files. For a few of the 144 files I am working on, I get an error:

Error in dim(data) <- c(channels, length(data)/channels) : 
  dims [product 428] do not match the length of object [429]

I have open the files in other sound analysis programs (Raven) without a problem. 

I guess is something simple but I dont get it. Does anyone know what might be the issue?  

You can download one of the files from here (https://www.dropbox.com/s/srgjze84ixbjy6c/VocatorParaguas009.WAV)

thanks in advance 



Marcelo Araya-Salas

Dear Marcelo,

The script you give does not seem to be enough to help.
What are the objects channels and data?
Anyway I would like to draw your attention and the attention of all seewave users on the fact that the package sound is no more maintained and no more available on CRAN.

I would then suggest to use the function readWave() of the package tuneR instead.

Best regards,

Jerome
